text: Write the opening section of a story called New Horizons, in which someone sets off on a long
journey. In your writing, create a sense of anticipation and adventure.
Write two contrasting pieces (300–450 words each), the first about a person before a job interview,
and the second about the same person after the job interview. In your writing, create a sense of
the person’s outlook and mood.
Write a descriptive piece called The Mountain. In your writing, create a sense of atmosphere, and
focus on colours and sounds to help your reader imagine the scene.
Section B: Writing for an audience
You have been asked to produce an article for your school magazine on how the ways in which
people communicate with each other have changed in your lifetime, and how they may change in
the future. Write the article. In your writing, show your interest in these changes.
A newspaper recently published an article called Prison – the best solution to crime. Readers
were invited to write letters to respond to this article. Write two letters (300–450 words each), one
supporting the views in the article, and the other challenging them. In your writing, create a sense
of reasoned argument.
A resort hotel is producing an online video advertisement of its facilities. The video is aimed at
prospective guests who might be interested in staying at the hotel. Write the script for the voiceover
of the video. In your writing, create a sense of enthusiasm for the hotel and its facilities.
